configs.rationale: Breakout of the prior 1-day extreme on a closed 15m candle with volume confirmation (volume_ratio_20 >= 1.2) and 1-day ATR%-rank <= 0.5 (volatility compression). Stop 2.0xATR15, ATR trailing 4.0xATR15 to ride expansion; max hold 6 days. Economic basis: stop-run/expansion after compression.

15m trend defined by EMA stack (close vs ema200 and ema50 vs ema200); entry when price pulls back to ema20 (band 0.2%) and closes back on the trend side with RSI in the neutral band. Stop 1.5xATR15, fixed target 1.5R, max hold 2 days. Economic basis: trend participants absorb pullbacks at the dynamic mean, giving tight-invalidation asymmetric entries.
